criteria.criterion: Access Google Finance and attempt to locate Apple (AAPL) page
criteria.final_justification: The agent clearly found Apple in Google Finance search results (visible AAPL row), which satisfies the ‘attempt to locate Apple’ aspect. But visual evidence does not confirm that the Apple company/quote page itself loaded/displayed. So keep high but not perfect credit vs a strict ‘reached dedicated page’ requirement.

criteria.criterion: Access Google Finance and attempt to locate Microsoft (MSFT) page
criteria.final_justification: No evidence the agent searched for or opened Microsoft’s page. Also, the claimed platform/UI blocker is not confirmed by screenshots (search dropdown works and shows results for Apple), so this is a controllable omission rather than an uncontrollable blocker applying to sibling criteria.

criteria.criterion: Report Apple metrics and latest visible news headline (or unavailability)
criteria.final_justification: Agent output incorrectly claimed that even Apple’s current share price was not visible, which is contradicted by the dropdown showing $319.70. They also failed to report the visible price. Market cap, YTD, and latest Apple news headline are indeed not visible anywhere, but the agent’s blanket ‘nothing visible’ statement is inaccurate. Minimal partial credit for at least having a visible price available in the UI, but not extracted/reported.

criteria.criterion: Report Microsoft metrics and latest visible news headline (or unavailability)
criteria.final_justification: Agent did not obtain or report any of the required Microsoft fields, and there is no screenshot-confirmed uncontrollable blocker preventing searching MSFT (the search UI appears functional). Thus this is a failure to attempt/complete the Microsoft portion.

criteria.criterion: Provide a comparison and identify which company has larger market capitalization
criteria.final_justification: Because the inability to compare stems from the agent not performing the Microsoft lookup and not extracting the needed Apple fields (a controllable failure), downstream comparison cannot earn credit under cascading-dependency rules (Scenario B). The agent also did not use an alternative source consistently for both to answer the market-cap-winner question.
